items.title: Typeahead — AI autocomplete for your entire Mac
items.snippet:
Typeahead — AI autocomplete for your entire Mac
[...]
Finishes your sentences across every app on your Mac. Runs locally. Your words never leave your computer.
[...]
Built for macOS
[...]
Optimized for Apple Silicon. Fast, lightweight, and feels like it belongs on your Mac.
[...]
### Works in Every Mac App
[...]
From your email to your editor. Slack to Notion. If you can type in it, Typeahead works.
[...]
## Your words never leave your Mac.
[...]
Works Everywhere on Mac
[...]
Private by design. Every word you type is processed on your Mac by local AI models. Nothing is sent to the cloud. Works offline, works on a plane. Your data is yours alone.
[...]
No subscriptions. No recurring fees. Pay once and Typeahead is yours for life.
[...]
Typeahead —
[...]
I get Typeahead?
[...]
Purchase for $79 and download immediately. One payment, then it's yours forever.
